// PROBE for tests/unit/advisor-requests-reach-a-visible-advisor.test.ts.
//
// The recipient defect: an arbitrary relationship, gated on `status: "active"`,
// with no check that this advisor can see THIS policy. Not compiled — the guard
// reads it as text.

export async function requestSomethingFromAdvisor(policyId: string) {
    const relationship = await db.customerRelationship.findFirst({
        where: { policyholderUserId: dbUser.id, status: "active" },
        select: { id: true, agentUserId: true },
    })
    if (!relationship) return { error: "NO_AGENT" }

    await collaborationService.ensureAutomationThread(dbUser.id, {
        relationshipId: relationship.id,
        policyId,
        category: RENEWAL_QUOTE_REQUEST.category,
        priority: RENEWAL_QUOTE_REQUEST.priority,
        subject: RENEWAL_QUOTE_REQUEST.subject.el,
        initialMessage: RENEWAL_QUOTE_REQUEST.message.el,
    })

    return { success: true }
}
